# Registry seed for `scen-check-prompt-names-its-tiers`.
#
# The seed of scen-check-fix-rewrites-description-qualifier: one Scenario
# whose description says "quickly", a forbidden qualifier, where its then
# step states the measurable criterion, 100 milliseconds. The walk's one
# Prompt names its own tiers, so which CLI each turn went to says whose
# tier won.

metadata:
  title: "Test Requirements Registry (BDD fixture seed)"
  version: "2.0"
  last_updated: "2026-10-22"
  description: "One scenario with a vague word in its description"

scenarios:
  E2E-001:
    description: The greeter must print the configured greeting followed by the name it is given and exit within 100 milliseconds
    service: greeter
    path: tests/greeter/greet_test.go
    user_stories: []
    merged_steps:
      given:
        - the greeting is configured as "Hello"
      when:
        - the Operator runs "greet Ada"
      then:
        - the command exits with code 0 within 100 milliseconds
        - and: stdout matches ^Hello Ada$
